svg.title: Arda Çabuk — embedded software and machine learning
svg.desc: A ray-marched room at night, drawn in ASCII. A red neon sign on the back wall reads ARDA ÇABUK and stutters now and then. In the foreground someone with short curly dark-blond hair, a pale hoodie and headphones with a red ear cup sits in profile at a desk against the left wall, lit by an amber desk lamp, nodding to the music and typing; the monitor reads arda@jetson and shows a scrolling vibration trace marked nominal, a development board blinks beside the keyboard, steam rises from a mug and a pair of drumsticks lies on the desk. Between the desk and the window stands a drum kit, its cymbals catching the moonlight. Through a tall arched window a cat sits on the sill against the horizon, a crescent moon hangs in a slate sky, stars twinkle, shooting stars cross, cars pass on the hill road and wind turbines turn on the ridge with red lights blinking. Fairy lights twinkle under the ceiling and dust drifts in the moonlight falling through the window.
